reasons.benchmarks/conservation/report.json: conservation audit (G1 pressure-gradient leak, G1b viscous-pair closed form, G2 CSF/viscous leak, G3 Galilean, G4 ballistic lag) of the sigma=7.2 N/m hexagonal droplet from benchmarks/conservation/run.py; it reports per-invariant leaks and pass/fail verdicts, not one measured-vs-reference reading, so it cannot be a single ladder entry. Guarded by tests/test_conservation.py.
reasons.benchmarks/init_consistency/report.json: zeroth-moment (kernel-sum) audit of WCSPH initial conditions from benchmarks/init_consistency/run.py (mission m3114), criterion |p_false|/(rho0 c0^2) < 1e-4, with an h/dx sweep and a Laplace-plateau reproduction; a bug-attribution sweep, no single measured-vs-reference reading. The production consequence (initial-mass calibration) is registered separately as the lattice-mass claims.
reasons.benchmarks/initial_density_bias/report.j: initial sum-density lattice-bias audit (backlog_update_m2971.md P1) from benchmarks/initial_density_bias/run.py: seven analytic/boolean gates on the bias formula, the h/dx dependence and the calibration helper, plus a c0 ladder; nothing in it is a single reading against an experimental reference. Guarded by tests/test_initial_density_calibration.py.
reasons.benchmarks/laplace_pressure_closure/raw/: raw dx-ladder dump behind the free-surface pressure-closure study (benchmarks/laplace_pressure_closure/analysis.py); it holds per-dx intermediate relaxation records that are only meaningful together with the parent study and its figure script, and is treated like the laplace_law/convergence relax_*.json waivers.
reasons.benchmarks/lattice_equilibrium/report.js: lattice-equilibrium audit of the resting state from benchmarks/lattice_equilibrium/run.py (bias curve, production and dynamic runs, hydrostatic profile, acceptance ratio 1e-4); multi-metric audit with boolean gates rather than one measured-vs-reference reading. Guarded by tests/test_lattice_equilibrium.py.
reasons.benchmarks/oscillating_droplet_instabili: energy-budget / divergence audit of the recorded oscillating-droplet traces (benchmarks/oscillating_droplet_instability/run.py), i.e. the provenance of the mode-2 reading. It withholds a measurement instead of adding one, so it must not become a ladder entry; the mode-2 numbers stay on the existing oscillating_droplet claim. Guarded by tests/test_oscillating_droplet_instability.py and written up in docs/verification_oscillating_droplet_instability.md.
